organization: ISSOL, the International Society for the Study of the Origin of Life
field: origins of life, RNA world, astrobiology

notes: society reports 500+ members in 20+ countries; route questions through the public page

organization: ISSOL meetings and affiliated origins meetings
public_contact_or_submission: public meetings calendar on society site
why_relevant: lists EANA2026, IOoL2026 (Tokyo), AbGradCon 2026, and Origins and Diversification of Life 2026; ground-visible presentation venues
notes: check current dates and abstract deadlines before submitting

organization: Discover Life (formerly Origins of Life and Evolution of Biospheres)
field: origins of life, RNA replication fidelity
why_relevant: the field's specialist journal; open access, single-anonymous review, Research and Perspective article types
notes: submission requires manuscript, abstract under 250 words, and cover letter; article processing charge applies

why_relevant: publishes experimental, computational and theoretical work on the evolution of informational macromolecules; runs a 'A Road to LUCA' collection linking prebiotic chemistry to life
notes: hybrid journal; traditional publishing route available without open access fee

why_relevant: open preprint server with Evolutionary Biology and Synthetic Biology subject areas; a fast, opt-in route to a checkable public record
notes: preprints are not peer reviewed; use as a dated public record of the claim and refuter

public_contact_or_submission: public contact and mailing list sign-up
why_relevant: public research opportunities, events and an opt-in mailing list; relevant to origins-of-life information questions
notes: site states it is being migrated to science.nasa.gov/astrobiology; follow the redirect

organization: Gordon Research Conference on Origins of Life
public_contact_or_submission: public conference history and contact page
